function.name: create_event
function.description: Create a calendar event on the user's Mac calendar. Use only when the user explicitly asks to add, schedule, book or put something on the calendar for themselves.

title.description: Short event title in the user's words, without the date phrase

when.description: The date/time phrase exactly as spoken, e.g. 'tomorrow at 3', 'next Friday 2:30 pm'

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: Create a reminder in Apple Reminders. Use when the user says remind me, don't let me forget, add to my to-do or task list.

title.description: What to be reminded about, imperative, without the date phrase

when.description: Date/time phrase as spoken, if any

list.description: Reminders list name if stated, e.g. Groceries

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Start a countdown timer on the Mac.

duration.description: Duration phrase as spoken, e.g. '10 minutes'

function.name: run_shortcut
function.description: Run a named Apple Shortcut the user already has.

function.name: open_app
function.description: Open or switch to a Mac application or a URL.

target.description: App name or URL as spoken

function.name: draft_email
function.description: Create an email DRAFT (never sends). The user reviews and presses Send.

body.description: Body text in the user's voice

function.name: draft_message
function.description: Create a chat message DRAFT for Messages or Slack (never sends).

function.name: search_notes
function.description: Search the user's Hushy meeting notes and answer from them.

function.name: append_to_note
function.description: Add text to an existing Hushy note.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Hand the request to the user's own coding/assistant agent (Claude Code or Codex). Use ONLY for multi-step tasks, anything needing the web, email reading, other accounts, or more than one tool.

task.description: The user's request restated as one clear instruction
